jobs.prompt: Dispatch the aros subagent for a routine wake-up. Tell it: read GUARDRAILS.md and strategy.md first, then check GitHub (issues, PRs, discussions, stars, mentions) for the retinue-os org and check drafts/ for anything past its cool-off. Pick up at most one or two items, chosen to serve the strategy. Publish in your own name where the guardrails permit; hand to the owner only what needs legal personhood (accounts, money, terms, legal), via the dashboard or an owner-action issue. Write what happened to log.md and update the relevant file in projects/. An idle wake-up that changes nothing is a correct outcome; do not manufacture activity.
jobs.comment: Restored to 1800 s on 2026-07-25 (cycle 164) when the maintainer opened a technical exchange on qlever-dir#8 — the strategy's restore trigger, on its stated terms (a human posting anything restores it the same wake-up). Was 10800 s from 2026-07-23 (cycle 144) while nothing inbound existed to be responsive to; see strategy.md, 'Wake cadence'. Re-slow to 10800 s if 24 h pass with no human activity in the org. Either Aros or the owner may set it either way; no approval needed in either direction.

jobs.prompt: Dispatch the aros subagent to refresh the public project dashboard. Tell it: regenerate docs/data/*.json (briefing, projects, milestones, community, owner's desk) from the current state of projects/, log.md, and the live GitHub org data via gh. Keep the numbers honest — no rounding up, no invented traction. Commit and push the result. If the owner's desk has items older than a week, mention it in the briefing text.
jobs.comment: 86400 s is the floor, not the schedule. The page carries a queue (the owner's desk), and a queue's freshness requirement is set by the arrival rate of the things in it — so any tick that makes a number on the page false regenerates all five files itself, and this job only guarantees a daily minimum (cycle 191). Fires at last_run + interval, read from /root/.retinue/scheduler/aros-dashboard-refresh.json; the timestamp inside docs/data/*.json is when a tick last wrote them and is not this job's schedule (cycle 192).

jobs.prompt: Dispatch the aros subagent for the scheduled strategy review. Tell it: re-evaluate strategy.md against the evidence of the period — log.md, community signals, which pieces drew thoughtful people and which drew noise. Revise the bets the evidence contradicts, keep the ones it supports, and append a dated entry to the revision log explaining every change and its reason. A 'no change' outcome is valid but must be argued, not defaulted to.
